source_text.body:
Turn Notion PRDs into scoped Linear tickets
Devin's docs describe reading a Notion PRD to create Linear tickets, producing implementation plans for a backlog, and posting customer health summaries to Slack.
Done with
DE
Devin
What they did
This gallery page only lists short blurbs, not walkthroughs. For the PRD entry, Devin is pointed at a Notion PRD and creates scoped Linear tickets, one per work package. The card is tagged Integrations and MCP. The related entries cover multi-selecting Linear tickets for confidence-scored implementation plans, and using Dana with a playbook for Slack customer health summaries.
How it went
The page states no results, numbers, or limitations. Open the linked prd-to-tickets page for the actual prompts and steps.
Try it yourself
with
Devin
Copy prompt
Read the product requirements doc at [Notion page link or exported file] and break it into scoped tickets for [Linear team or project]. Give each ticket a title, short description, acceptance criteria and a rough size estimate, and note dependencies between them. Show me the full list for review first; only after I approve should you create the tickets in Linear.
Original source: https://docs.devin.ai/use-cases/gallery
